basic_info.description: Don't Miss This One! In this classic and modernized 2 bedroom condo (with garage parking & gorgeous backyard!), live right between Valencia and Guerrero Streets and blocks from Dolores Park! This unbeatable Mission Dolores location is quiet, yet surrounded by many restaurants, cafes, shops and dedicated bike lane of the Valencia corridor. This first floor Edwardian flat offers a great open floorplan at the back of the property, leading to the English-style garden right off the kitchen, and a delightful office nook. These living spaces are awash with afternoon sunshine, and the shared backyard on this generous sized lot is perfect for relaxing and barbecuing. Packed with charm in every room, the condo features hardwood floors, box-beam ceilings and wainscoting. You truly must see to appreciate! With 2 bedrooms, one with a decorative fireplace, updated bathroom, spacious living and dining areas, attractive kitchen with counter seating, in-unit washer/dryer, storage, side-by-side garage parking, and low HOA fees ($290/month), you'll want to make this condominium your next home. Freeways and BART are minutes away.
